name: v0.3.9 — Dashboard Guac-AI pill scroll + WizardScore drift fix + cross-platform parity tests
releaseNotes:
• Dashboard greeting now sits right above one horizontal-scroll row of nine Guac-AI pills (Worth It? · Guacanomics · GuacWizard · Steals · Rewards · Stash · Inbox · Car Miles · How It Works) — same widget the Profile screen uses, no more rectangular feature-card rows further down the page.
• Profile screen 5×2 Guac-AI grid also collapsed to one horizontal scroll.
• WizardScore engine — synthetic-account fallback when user has bank_fees but no bank_statements (was triggering the 50/100 baseline path). Plus accept either totalPurch/totalPurchases field naming to match the Dart engine.
• Cross-platform parity tests landed — fixture file at test-fixtures/score-engines.json, runs through BOTH Dart (mobile/test/services/wizard_score_test.dart) AND JS (web/scripts/test-score-engines.mjs). 9/9 cases produce identical scores on both sides. `npm run test:parity` runs both suites.
